login_lead: Sign in with the login name and password from your supplier, or have a code sent to your e-mail.
error_send_failed: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
description_empty: No description has been added for this project yet.
attachment_error_too_many: You can attach at most {max} files.
attachment_error_type: The file "{name}" cannot be uploaded - the type {ext} is not allowed.
attachment_error_size: The file "{name}" is too large (max {maxMb} MB).
help_intro_text: The project portal is where you follow the progress of your project and talk to your supplier. Everything is in the menu on the left – here is what each part does.
help_checkpoints_text: The steps of the project in their order with their status (Not started, In progress, Done) and planned date. Click a step with a description to expand it. The overall progress in percent is on top.
help_threads_text: All written communication with the supplier, split into threads by topic. Start a new thread with "New thread" (subject, priority, description, attachments if needed). A thread shows the whole history, the author of every message ("You" for yours) and you reply in the box below. You can close a solved thread and reopen it any time. "Search communication" searches subjects and message texts.
help_attachments_text: You can attach several files to a new thread or a reply. Allowed types and the maximum size are checked right when you pick a file – if a file does not fit, the portal tells you why.
help_contacts_text: The contact person of your project at the supplier and the company and billing details of the supplier.
help_support_text: Write a new message in Communication or use the contact in Contacts. Forgot your password? You cannot change it yourself – ask the supplier, they will set a new one.
login_forgotten_hint: Forgot your password? Switch to "Code by e-mail" or contact your supplier.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in a moment.
overview_waiting_on_you_hint: The supplier waits for your answer
files_lead: All files you and the supplier sent in the threads, in one place. Click the topic to open the thread of a file.
files_empty: There are no files in the threads yet.
files_error: The files could not be loaded. Try refreshing the data.
supplier_contact_empty: The supplier has not filled in a contact person yet.
help_login_text: You sign in to the portal through the project link with your login name and password, or with a one-time code sent to your e-mail. Every person on your side can have their own account - ask the supplier for more. A sign-in lasts 24 hours from the last activity.
help_overview_text: A summary of the project in one place: what is new since your last visit, requests waiting for approval, progress in per cent, threads waiting for your reply, the estimated date, the current step and the project description. Click an item to go to its section.
help_waiting_title: Waiting on you / Supplier is answering
help_waiting_text: Every open thread shows whose turn it is. "Waiting on you" means the supplier wrote last and waits for your reaction. "Supplier is answering" means it is their turn. Unread messages from the supplier show as a red number in the menu and at the thread.
help_files_text: All the files of the project - from threads, updates and approval requests, yours and from the supplier. For security the download links are time-limited and reload whenever you open Files.
help_layout_text: The button with three lines in the top-left corner narrows the menu to icons (on a phone it slides the menu in). The arrows button in the top-right corner loads the latest data, although most of it refreshes by itself every 15 seconds. The flag next to it switches the portal language.
help_notifications_text: In My account you enter your e-mail and choose what to be e-mailed about: a reply from the supplier, a change of a step state or date, a new update, an approval request. Everything is off by default and you can switch it off any time. The e-mail contains only a title and a link to the portal, never the message text.
account_managed_by_supplier: The name, login name and password are managed by the supplier - write to them if they need changing. Without a password you sign in with a code by e-mail.
notifications_lead: Choose what we should e-mail you about. Everything is off by default. The e-mail never contains the message text – only the thread or step title and a link to the portal.
notify_replies_title: The supplier replies in a thread
notify_replies_hint: A new reply of the supplier in any thread of the project.
notify_checkpoint_status_hint: A project step starts or is done.
notify_checkpoint_dates_hint: The supplier sets, moves or removes the due date of a step.
notifications_need_email: Fill in an e-mail to turn notifications on.
notifications_save_failed: The settings could not be saved. Check the e-mail and try again.
login_code_lead: Enter the login name or the e-mail of your account. We will send you a one-time sign-in code.
login_code_hint: The code is sent only to the e-mail saved on the account. It is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.
login_code_sent: If the account exists and has an e-mail, we have sent a six-digit code to it. Please check your spam folder too.
error_code_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again or send yourself a new one.
error_code_request_failed: The code could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
error_link_invalid: The sign-in link is invalid, already used or expired. Sign in with your password or have a code sent by e-mail.
news_empty: Nothing new here in the last 90 days.
approvals_lead: Here the supplier asks for your approval - of a design, texts or a finished part, for example. Approving confirms they can go on; if something is not right, request changes with a comment.
approvals_empty: There are no approval requests yet.
approval_record_note: Your decision is saved with the account name and time, and the supplier is notified.
approval_comment_required: Please write what needs to change.
approval_decision_failed: The decision could not be saved. The request may have changed meanwhile - refresh the page and try again.
updates_lead: News from the supplier about what is done, what is happening now and what comes next.
updates_empty: The supplier has not published any update yet.
notify_updates_hint: A new progress report in the Updates section.
notify_approvals_hint: A new or reopened approval request.
account_signin_password_code: Password or code from the e-mail
account_signin_code: Code from the e-mail (no password set)
help_login_code_title: Sign in with a code or the invitation link
help_login_code_text: If your account has an e-mail, you can sign in without a password: choose "Code by e-mail", enter the login name or e-mail and type in the six-digit code (valid 15 minutes). The invitation from the supplier contains a link that signs you in with one click - valid 7 days and only once. Using a code or a link verifies your e-mail.
help_approvals_text: The supplier asks for your consent with a design or a finished part. A request shows the description, files and possibly the step and a deadline. Choose "Approve", or "Request changes" and write what to change. The decision is recorded in the history permanently and the supplier is notified. The number in the menu shows the requests waiting for you.
help_updates_text: Regular news from the supplier about the progress of the project, possibly with attachments. New updates also appear in the "What is new" card of the overview.
order_lead: Fill in your details and attach your materials – we will get back to you and agree on the next steps.
order_ico_error: The company ID may contain digits only.
order_phone_error: Digits, spaces and a leading "+" only (at most 20 characters).
order_gdpr_consent: I agree to the processing of personal data –
order_thanks_text: We have sent you a confirmation by e-mail. We will get back to you soon to agree on the next steps.
order_link_invalid_text: This link to the order form does not exist or was removed. Please contact your sales representative.
order_link_used_text: The link can be used once and was used already. If you need to add something, please contact your sales representative.
order_link_expired_text: A link to the order form is valid for 30 days. Please ask your sales representative for a new one.
order_error_submit: The order could not be sent. Please try again.
order_error_too_many: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
order_error_attachment: The server refused one of the attachments (type or size not allowed). Check the attachments and send the form again.
order_error_captcha: The check that you are not a robot failed or expired. Please send the form again.
order_error_captcha_load: The check that you are not a robot could not be loaded. Please reload the page or allow content from challenges.cloudflare.com.
order_error_email_limit: We have received several orders from this e-mail address recently. You can send another one later or contact us.
order_upload_limits_hint: (max. {max} files, {maxMb} MB per file, {totalMb} MB in total)
order_upload_dropzone: Choose files or drop them here
order_upload_error_max_files: You can upload at most {max} files.
order_upload_error_file_too_large: The file "{filename}" exceeds the limit of {maxMb} MB.
order_upload_error_total_size: The attachments must not exceed {maxMb} MB in total.
order_upload_error_file_type: The file "{filename}" cannot be uploaded – the type {ext} is not allowed.
order_doc_error: The document could not be loaded. Please try again later.
